answer_2.quote: We measure average SSIM per glyph, having scaled pixel intensities to [0, 1]... We also include L2 numbers in Appendix B...

answer_4.quote: We also perform human evaluation using Amazon Mechanical Turk. For each font in our test set, 5 turkers were shown 8 example glyphs, and a sample of reconstructions... Turkers were asked to select which reconstruction was better, and briefly justify their reasoning.
answer_4.guideline: Turkers were shown example glyphs and asked to choose which reconstruction was better, providing a brief justification.
